business_problem: Renault needed a consistent, reliable, and personalized way to guide online vehicle shoppers from discovery to servicing, especially for electric and hybrid questions, without forcing visitors to manually search across site content before speaking with dealers.
solution_summary: Renault Group built askrnlt in-house as a customer-facing agentic AI advisor embedded in renault.fr and renault.es. The front-end conversational experience runs through askrnlt, while an orchestrator agent analyzes each visitor request and routes it to the right capability, such as vehicle configuration or product knowledge. The orchestration layer is powered by Gemini 2.5 Flash for natural interactions. To answer and act, the system draws on multiple connected sources: Renault brand website content for product and journey information, the Renault brand configurator for vehicle selection and prefilled configuration paths, a pricing API for commercial data, and an askrnlt confidential database for internal knowledge, alongside Gemini’s general knowledge. Responses are served back as natural-language guidance enriched with images, videos, deep links, and context-aware redirects, with guardrails and human oversight in place to resist misuse and keep answers reliable.

data_flow: Visitor questions and browsing context on renault.fr or renault.es enter askrnlt, where the orchestrator agent running on Gemini 2.5 Flash classifies the request and invokes the right capability. It retrieves product content from the Renault brand website, configuration data from the Renault brand configurator, prices from the pricing API, and internal knowledge from the askrnlt confidential database, then returns rich answers, links, images, videos, or prefilled configurator journeys to the visitor.
business_outcome: askrnlt improved Renault's digital customer experience by giving shoppers faster, more personalized guidance, increasing engagement with the assistant, boosting completed mobile configurations, and better preparing customers before dealer conversations.
metrics: The open rate of askrnlt has tripled compared with the previous chatbot.
On mobile, complete configurations are multiplied by 3 between user without askrnlt and user who had a chat with askrnlt.
60% of the questions relate to vehicles and their configuration first. Financing is the third topic of interest.
more than 50 000 chats with askrnlt since its launch.
architecture_clues: Available on renault.fr since November 2025 and on renault.es since April 2026.
Multi-agent architecture with an orchestrator and specialized agents.
Guardrails were added to protect against jailbreak attempts and misuse.
Human oversight remains in place to ensure correct behavior and source retrieval.
The deployment covers the full passenger car range.
Renault plans rollout to Italy, Germany, the United Kingdom and Brazil by the end of 2026.
